gameplay.name: Gameplay Activity
gameplay.description: The action of playing the serious game where participants game interaction data are collected via the xAPI component (trackers in the code), designed to integrate educational content in an engaging manner.
gameplay.storage.title: Trace Storage
gameplay.storage.description: Enable the collection and download of the interaction data collected during the gameplay activity.
gameplay.result.title: Backup
gameplay.result.description: Enable the collection and download of backups during the gameplay activity.
gameplay.restarted.title: Allow restarting?
gameplay.restarted.description: Allow participants to restart the gameplay activity after completion, which can be useful for collecting multiple rounds of interaction data or allowing participants to improve their performance.
gameplay.platform.title: Platform
gameplay.web.title: Web
gameplay.web.description: The gameplay activity is based on a web game launched in an iframe, and the interaction data is collected via xAPI statements sent from the game to SIMVA.
gameplay.game_uri.title: Game URI
gameplay.game_uri.description: The URI of the game being played can be specified to launch the game that collects xAPI data.
gameplay.desktop.title: Desktop Game
gameplay.desktop.description: The gameplay activity is based on a desktop game launched on the user's machine, and the interaction data is collected via xAPI statements sent from the game to SIMVA.
gameplay.xapi_by_game.title: Basic xAPI Data Management By Game
gameplay.xapi_by_game.description: Enable the management of basic xAPI data (activity initialized, suspended/resumed, activity terminated) directly by the game.
gameplay.trackerSettings.title: Tracker type
gameplay.trackerSettings.description: Depending on the type of tracker the game uses, the activity will provide a specific settings file
gameplay.trackerSettings.xasu.title: Standalone Xasu Tracker
gameplay.trackerSettings.simvaUnity.titl: Xasu Tracker along with the Simva Unity plugin
gameplay.trackerSettings.other.title: Custom tracker
gameplay.xasu.title: Xasu Config
gameplay.xasu.description: The xAPI statement configuration (xASU) can be specified to customize the xAPI data collection during the gameplay activity.
manual.name: Manual Activity
manual.description: A traditional learning exercise to be undertaken by participants such as reading a book, reading an article, watching a video or any other passive learning task.
manual.student_complete.title: Allow students to complete?
manual.student_complete.description: Allow students to mark the activity as complete.
manual.restarted.title: Allow restarting?
manual.restarted.description: Allow participants to restart the manual activity after completion, which can be useful for collecting multiple rounds of interaction data or allowing participants to improve their performance.
manual.storage.title: Trace Storage
manual.storage.description: Enable the collection and download of xAPI interaction data collected during the manual activity.
manual.platform.title: Platform
manual.web.title: Web
manual.web.description: The manual activity is based on a web resource launched in an iframe, and the interaction data is collected via xAPI statements sent from the resource to SIMVA.
manual.uri.title: URI
manual.uri.description: The URL of the resource to be accessed in the manual activity.
manual.external.title: External Resource
manual.external.description: The manual activity is based on an external resource launched outside of SIMVA, and the interaction data is collected via xAPI statements sent from the resource to SIMVA.
